observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same blue plastic barrel/drum, roughly 200L size, standing outdoors among similar drums and jerrycans.
Drum has a removable lid held down by three metal clamp/hinge bands; two of the clamps show visible rust.
Two threaded bung caps are visible on the lid, both appear closed.
Drum exterior shows scuffs, scratches, dirt, and a green painted mark/number on the side.
No resin identification code, manufacturer stamp, or food-grade certification mark is legible in either photo.
No close-up of the drum interior, base, or walls is provided, so condition there is unknown.
Background shows other drums and containers, suggesting a bulk resale yard rather than a single verified unit.

claims.evidence: Generic marketing statement; no photo can confirm overall 'quality'.
No resin code, HDPE marking, or food-grade stamp is visible in photo 0 or photo 1.

claims.claim: Used only once for clean water
claims.evidence: No documentation or prior-use proof shown; surface staining and rust on hinges are consistent with more than light use, but not conclusive from photos.
No close-up of walls/base or a water-fill test is shown in photo 0 or photo 1.
Both photo 0 and photo 1 show an intact lid with two bung caps and three clamp bands in place.

risks.risk: Drum may have held non-food chemicals previously, making it unsafe for drinking water storage despite the 'food grade' claim.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the embossed resin code/manufacturer markings on the drum base or side, or a photo of any original content label still present.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an industrial/non-food-grade drum, not suitable for potable water

risks.risk: Hidden cracks or seam leaks not visible under current lighting/angle.
risks.proof: A video of the empty drum being filled with water and checked for leaks, or close-up shots of the base and side seams.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a drum with unverified leak risk, i.e. as if leaking

risks.risk: Rusted metal clamps may not seal the lid properly, allowing contamination ingress.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of each clamp/hinge mechanism showing it closes fully and the gasket (if any) is intact.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a compromised/non-sealing lid

proof_requests: Close-up of the resin/recycling code and any manufacturer or food-grade stamp on the drum.
Video of the drum filled with water, checked for leaks at base and seams.
Close-up of each lid clamp/hinge showing it latches fully and the lid gasket is intact.
Photo showing any prior content label or cleaning certificate, if available.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a used blue plastic storage drum with a lid, but no comparable listings were supplied to establish even a worst-case price, and key claims like food-grade status and leak-free condition remain unverified.
